key_insight: Distilling a neural network into closed-form equations yields interpretable predictions of when multi-planet systems become dynamically unstable.
engineering_relevance: The approach shows how neural predictors of complex dynamics can be converted into compact equations for scientific analysis.
method: Train a neural network on N-body simulations of planetary systems.
Use symbolic regression to distill learned relationships into algebraic expressions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the equations outperform existing analytic instability estimates across wide ranges of mass ratios, orbital spacing, and eccentricities, but provides no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Validate the equations outside the simulated parameter ranges before relying on extrapolated instability predictions.
paper_title: Distilling neural networks into equations to predict planetary instability
